name: Lukla Airport
groundLayout: Runway 09/27 (short, steep approach - Lukla's real-world claim to fame). Taxiway A connects Main Apron (Terminal, Fuel) to the runway near the Rwy 09 end. Taxiway B branches off mid-field to the Heli Apron. Control Tower sits between the two. Real taxiway letters: A, B.
